description: Single Schedule C, taxable income before QBI over the $197,300 Form 8995-A threshold.
derivation: RP 2024-40 § 3.27 threshold $197,300. Profit $250,000. SE net 230,875; SS 12.4% × $176,100 = $21,836; Medicare 2.9% × 230,875 = $6,695; SE tax $28,531; half $14,266. AGI $235,734. Std $15,750. TI before QBI $219,984, which is above $197,300, so Form 8995-A applies. No W-2/UBIA, so the wage limit may reduce the deduction.
